title: My mall world jumped the shark
content: Once again, I was trying to find my way out of mall world so I could get back home. I kept asking people where the exit was, and I couldn’t believe that no one could tell me. In fact, whoever I asked just morphed into a psychedelic blob. then I looked up at the sky through a window and saw the full moon… And behind it, a crescent moon… And above the two moons was planet earth.
